messages:
Maya: Quick ask to runtime — can we get a targeted rerun + sample annotation for the 'launch-hotpath' cohort? Need provenance + per-run warmup traces for the webinar deck. High level:
- 500 seeded samples across short+long contexts
- Run both fp16 and int8 quantized variants
- Deliver per-request: p50/p95 latency, token counts, warmup vs cold breakdown, KV cache hit rate
Target: EOD Thu. @AJ can you triage?

AJ: On it. Quick q: please attach the exact seed + payload manifest and the trace keys we should collect. Also confirm model/commit and any runtime flags.

Maya: Manifest below. Cohort name: launch-hotpath-v1. Seed=42. Payload set: press-demo (I'll upload the JSON list to the shared workspace). Model: redwood-serve/2.1-medium. Run flags: --quantize=8 and fp16 baseline. Output we need: raw traces (per-token timing), annotated CSV columns: sample_id, origin, prompt_len, response_len, latency_ms, variant.

Sofia: Also can you add a simple hallucination marker? We flagged ~12 examples in the reference file — boolean if response deviates from reference beyond threshold. It's ok if quantized runs differ, just mark which ones changed.

Ken: We can add a post-run similarity check if you drop the references into the run workspace. Note: quantized outputs may have legitimate diffs; we'll include a note on deterministic vs statistical diffs.

AJ: Queuing two jobs now (fp16, int8). If cluster is busy we'll fall back to a 200-sample smoke to unblock your deck. Runtime bot will emit job ids.

Runtime Bot: Job queued: job_id=run-20240314-8812 (fp16), job_id=run-20240314-8813 (int8). ETA ~3h. Tracking: https://internal.redwood/jobs/run-20240314-8812

Maya: Thanks. One more ask — can you break out cold-start vs warmed-path percentiles? Marketing wants to show delta (we expect warmup improves p95 by ~20%). Also include a short note on warmup protocol.

Ken: We'll provide cold vs warmed percentiles and add warmup protocol details: short context = 5 warmup calls, long context = 10 warmup calls, cache priming uses exact prefixes. We'll include KV cache hit rate per request and per-prefix warmup success rate.

AJ: What tags should we embed into artifacts for marketing ingestion (campaign, demo version, run seed)? Also retention for raw logs?

Maya: Tags: campaign=launch-apr2026, demo=press-demo, cohort=launch-hotpath-v1, owner=marketing. Keep raw logs for 30 days and artifacts (CSV + traces) in the shared bucket.

Runtime Bot: Run started: run-20240314-8812 (fp16) @ 1736604400. Expected finish ~1736606800. Upload location: s3://redwood-internal/runs/run-20240314-8812/

Sofia: If anything looks off or we see huge divergence, ping me here. We'll need a 1-slide summary + the CSV artifact when ready.

Ken: Will do — we'll post artifacts + a short checklist when runs complete. :thumbsup:

---
Attachment (manifest snippet):
```json
[
  {"sample_id": "s-0001", "source": "press-demo/short/1.txt"},
  {"sample_id": "s-0002", "source": "press-demo/long/42.txt"},
  ...
]
```

Notes: sample provenance must include original uploader and timestamp, and we want a mapping file in the artifact bundle. Maya will upload full payloads to the shared workspace within 30m.
